name: UNIPOLAR-N18-307-v2

objective_boundary.purpose: Produce a real 307/128-bpw coarse stream only after source closure, independent review and runtime authentication, enabling a later TACTIC-DH384 or broader CAGE experiment.
objective_boundary.universal_contract: Arbitrary positive SwiGLU-MoE Gate [intermediate,hidden], Up [intermediate,hidden], and Down [hidden,intermediate] shapes; Qwen is evaluation only.

packet.tail_rule: The final tile is implicitly zero-padded from its header-bound valid length, but its entire fixed reservoir is physical and charged.
packet.canonicality: MSB-first hard logical EOF, zero terminal pad, zero fixed-reservoir fill, payload SHA-256, header CRC32, independent arithmetic decode and byte-identical canonical re-encode required.

universal_seeds.overflow_policy: Terminal failure; no seed, profile, topology or role retry.

evaluation_order.step_1: Authenticate source closure, independent review, environment, dependencies, plan and held source FDs.
evaluation_order.step_2: Run only the three-role absolute source DH384 best-of-64 pilot on one coordinate-selected triplet.
evaluation_order.step_3: If no role survives, stop frozen DH384 full panels.
evaluation_order.step_4: Only after source survival generate decoded-Gaussian and structure-destroyed controls; never subtract a control from the absolute hard gate.
evaluation_order.step_5: A survivor may authorize a complete source/control artifact and one nested physical evaluation after separate review.
evaluation_order.cage_nonconverse: Failure of the rank-384 best-of-64 DH384 span oracle does not kill graph lifting, posterior centroid, adaptive refinement tree, syndrome/coset, or any broader TACTIC-CAGE mechanism it does not dominate.

publication.inputs: Canonical absolute component-wise no-follow paths held by descriptor and rehashed before completion.
publication.output: Absent canonical absolute leaf, private staging directory, O_EXCL/O_NOFOLLOW files, file and directory fsync, COMPLETE.json created last, atomic renameat2(RENAME_NOREPLACE), parent fsync.

runtime.telemetry: Exact logical enumerated H2D/D2H/model H2D bytes, CUDA event phases, wall time, host RSS, baseline-subtracted NVML process/device VRAM, CuPy pool, versions, UUID and PCI mapping. Logical bytes are not claimed physical PCIe traffic.

claim_boundary: Source-only postimplementation candidate. No manifest or external review can turn a failed DH384 pilot into a converse for CAGE.
